title: ddd.yaml
description: The project's words for things, in the shape of a Contextive glossary: bounded contexts, the files each covers, and its terms.

directional.description: Words that give a name a direction, so us_to_uk and uk_to_us aren't name drift.

contexts.description: The project's words for things, in the shape of a Contextive glossary. A context with no paths holds the words of the whole project. The glossary sits in zanity.yaml or in ddd.yaml, not both.

imports.description: Contextive's imports of other glossaries; zanity reads past them.

name.description: What the context is called; a context with paths needs one.

kind.description: A context's words win over a domain's, and the same name may be defined once in each context.

paths.description: The files it covers, in .gitignore syntax, relative to this file. Quote a pattern that starts with *.

forbidden.description: Words no name in it may use, such as [util, manager].

domainVisionStatement.description: Contextive's summary of the context; zanity reads past it.

meta.description: Contextive's details about the context; zanity reads past them.

name.description: The project's word; a name using one of its aliases is respelled with it.

aliases.description: The words it replaces, such as [client, user].

definition.description: What it means, for Contextive's hovers.

examples.description: Sentences using it, for Contextive's hovers.

meta.description: Contextive's details about the term; zanity reads past them.
